devices.name: Core2
board_work: more than eight instances and sustained HCI/GATT throughput
blockers: Core2 legacy UIFlow shared I2C, equal-deadline timer and TIMG WDT-mask semantics are fixed. Patches 0036-0042 add stateful SSI, unified timeline, exact-time pause/state sweep, BIN-bound setter trace, bounded register/object/stack dumps, and a partial SPI TRANS_DONE/TRANS_INTEN IRQ model. TG0 stage-0 is masked at about 5.91 s and TG0 stage-1 triggers the first reset at about 15.91 s while TG1 remains live. WDT-off 45/120 s controls show Flash/SSI activity ending around 44 s, followed by CPU0 waiti idle and CPU1 at 0x40100049 in LVGL lv_refr_vdb_flush waiting on a double-buffered vdb with flushing=1 and a null wait_cb. The display flush_cb at 0x40174758 runs, but completion 0x40174884 and lv_disp_flush_ready are not observed. The early 800 ms TG1 gap is NOT_REPRODUCED, and the remaining issue is the SPI interrupt/queue completion chain, not a permanent cross-core deadlock, UART storm, TG1 feed stop, never-ending Flash scan or unknown late object. Temporary bulk-read and watchdog-disable diagnostics are not product fixes
physical cache/PSRAM timing equivalence remains NOT RUN
bit-exact ESP32 BT baseband/controller remains NOT RUN
virtual-device concurrency gates cover the current service capacity; more-than-eight-instance stability, sustained throughput and teardown modes beyond active-stop remain OPEN (CORE2-02)
the bounded-TCG host-memory result is validated only for the tested long-hold workload

validation.ack_observability: Patch 0010 preserves opt-in ACK-state observability. In the historical zero-stagger five-instance diagnostic, the first Reset Complete response-to-HLI timestamp delta was 4.506306s of host trace time, not guest virtual time; at the first ACK check ack=NULL and semaphore count 0.
validation.concurrency_validation: Two independent two-instance no-stagger 4x120s gates pass 8/8, two independent three-instance 3x120s gates pass 6/6, and two independent four-instance 4x120s gates pass 8/8. Patch 0008 preallocates real guest HCI-event buffers and ACL mbufs while CPU0 is idle, and patch 0009 expands the real reserve to 8 event/4 ACL objects after the initial four-instance gate failed 1/4. Every passing lease records 36 events and 9 ACLs on the fast path, HLI 45/45 and hli-errors=0. Two independent five-instance 5x120s batches with a 30-second startup stagger pass 10/10. The earlier shift=auto zero-stagger five-instance cold start implementation remained unstable: one batch passed 5/5 and an independent confirmation failed 3/5. Trace and queue evidence showed the guest disabled interrupts during PSRAM init while icount shift=auto stretched scheduling under host contention, so controller events entered the queue but missed the NimBLE ACK window. In the historical 0010 5x20s diagnostic batch, the first Reset Complete response-to-HLI timestamp delta was 4.506306s of host trace time, not guest virtual time; at the first ACK check ack=NULL and semaphore count 0. The current default fixes icount shift=5 and starts the test BLE server before WiFi and sustained PSRAM work. Two independent zero-stagger five-instance gates pass 10/10 and two six-instance gates pass 12/12. An eight-instance 8x120s control under the former hold/10 floor failed 4/8 solely on the PSRAM sweep count, while all eight guests passed HCI/network/GATT/frame/QOM/pcap/evidence with zero HLI/reset/panic and the failed leases completed 11 contiguous sweeps. The control is retained. After calibrating the sustained floor to hold/12, two independent eight-instance 8x120s gates pass 8/8 each (16/16 total) at the service per-device cap of 8, completing 11-12 sweeps per lease with one recoverable prealloc transient per batch. More than eight instances, sustained throughput and teardown modes beyond active-stop remain OPEN.
validation.memory_validation: The m5core2 machine now exposes a QOM-effective 8 MiB PSRAM device. Normal ESP32 DRAM1 remains a 4 MiB directly mapped heap window; a dedicated ESP-IDF esp_himem probe passed in three independent Device Service leases, mapping two different 32 KiB physical blocks through the same virtual MMU window and verifying both after remap (4,456,448 bytes himem capacity, 262,144-byte reserve). Guest sustained stress remains PASS in three independent 120-second leases (35/35/35 checks, 105 MiB total) and one 600-second lease (179 checks). Physical PSRAM/cache timing remains NOT RUN.
validation.detail: Official UIFlow2 v2.5.3 runs the 320x240 display/touch, AXP2101, INA3221, MPU6886, PCF8563, NS4168 speaker, SPM1423 microphone, OpenMAC WiFi DHCP/HTTP, public DNS/HTTP and stock-firmware external BLE GATT in one m5core2 guest. The canonical Device Service profile core2-native-hci passes the HCI-4 functional baseline, bounded native-HCI holds, active-stop and current-service-capacity concurrency. Three independent leases complete 121 reconnect cycles with HLI 3405/3405; an artifact-bound tb-size=128 7200s active-BLE WiFi/public-network/GATT hold remains functionally PASS with bounded host memory. The eight-instance gate was rebound to the current tool hash after manifest/capability/security changes. The m5core2 machine exposes an 8 MiB PSRAM device and models DRAM1 32 KiB MMU pages. Legacy UIFlow now has replayable shared-I2C, CCOMPARE, TIMG WDT-mask, QIO/stateful-SSI, unified handoff, exact-time, setter-trace, WDT-liveness and WDT-off late-state evidence. BIN-bound analysis identifies the final CPU1 wait as LVGL lv_refr_vdb_flush with flushing=1; display flush_cb runs, but the SPI completion callback and lv_disp_flush_ready are not observed. Normal-WDT still resets from TG0 stage-1 with a black frame. The legacy core2-native-vhci profile remains diagnostic. Physical cache/PSRAM equivalence, more-than-eight-instance stability, sustained throughput, teardown modes beyond active-stop, a legacy non-empty application frame and a bit-exact Espressif BT baseband/controller remain open.

validation.detail: UIFlow2 P4 firmware boots through esp-emu 0.50.0 with the C6 ESP-Hosted bridge, renders a 1280x720 landscape frame from the real M5GFX framebuffer, and redraws after touch. P4 I2C scans Tab5 devices; INA226 preload reaches Power as 8000mV/1248mA/87%, direct machine.I2C write/read reaches RX8130 registers, PI4IOE output writeback passes, and CHG_STAT=0x00/0x40 reaches Power.isCharging() as charging/discharging. UART1 RS-485 half-duplex TX/RX passes against a host peer on G20/G21 with direction G34. RTC progression, dynamic BMI270/time/I2C injection, IP2326 analog current/termination behavior and the remaining native P4 data planes remain partial.
